kind: Market regime research — descriptive; nothing here is a buy or sell rule.

dataFaults.what: HYG on the chart API before 2007-04-11
dataFaults.detail: The chart API serves HYG from 2004-02-04 at about $25.1; the iShares high-yield fund only launched on 2007-04-11 (at about $104). The early stretch is a different instrument under a reused ticker. This study uses FMP's dividend-adjusted HYG, which starts 2007-04-11.

dataFaults.what: QQQ on the chart API has a hole 2004-11-30 → 2011-03-23
dataFaults.detail: The Nasdaq-100 fund traded as QQQQ in those years; the chart API's QQQ series skips them. The Nasdaq pairs here use FMP for both legs.

dataFaults.what: Equal-weight sector funds (RSPT, RSPF, RSPC …) on the chart API start 2023-06-07
dataFaults.detail: Invesco renamed them in 2023 (RYT→RSPT etc.). FMP carries the full history under the new tickers, split-adjusted; on the 829 overlapping sessions FMP and the chart API agree to within 0.02%.

dataFaults.what: Mid- and small-cap equal-weight funds stopped
dataFaults.detail: FMP's last prints: EWMC 2023-10-05, EWSC 2023-04-06 (zero volume). No live US mid/small equal-weight vs cap-weight pair was found on FMP; those two rows are history only.
